description: Reflected XSS occurs when user-supplied input is echoed in an HTTP response without sanitization, allowing script execution in the victim's browser. Detect via injecting `<script>alert(1)</script>`, event handlers like `onfocus`, HTML entity bypass, and encoding variants. Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, PHP Charset Encoder (PCE), Hackvertor, XSS-Proxy, ratproxy.
